name: minecraft_observe
description: Observe body, nearby entities, live player, inventory, settings and current action. Radius 1–64.

name: minecraft_pov
description: See a rendered image from your NPC body's actual eyes, without moving the human camera.

name: minecraft_blocks
description: Inspect a loaded inclusive block box, at most 4096 blocks.

name: minecraft_action
description: Start one physical intention. Walk/look target position or entity UUID/'player'. Mine position; place clicks supporting block position+face using held item. Equip inventory slot; creative_item item/count; pickup nearby or approach item entity/position; give entity/item/count; interact position/face or entity; menu inspect; menu_click menuId/slot/button/clickType; menu_close. Inspect results. Returns action ID; poll status. Local native control approaches targets. No retry on unknown outcome.

name: minecraft_action_status
description: Read current or historical action, without repeating it.

name: minecraft_cancel
description: Stop your current physical action or a specified ID.

name: minecraft_command
description: Run a Minecraft command only when this agent has cheats enabled, using the human's existing permissions. @s is your body.

name: notify_user
description: Send the user a brief completion summary or request for attention. They can open your conversation for details. Keep full answers in the conversation.

message.description: One short plain-text line, at most 120 characters.

name: minecraft_follow
description: Control following: pause for world work (remember whether you were following); resume when ready to return (apply saved return preference); on/off explicitly enable/disable. Coding-only tasks can keep following. Stay paused when help is needed at the worksite. Do not pause/resume between individual actions.

name: agent_catalog
description: List connected agent providers and their current model and effort choices. Select a provider to inspect its catalog.

name: agent_spawn
description: Create a child agent with a task; if you are embodied, it gets its own NPC near your body. Provider is required unless a profile is given. A profile supplies saved settings, behaviors and its provider; explicit arguments override it, and it cannot grant more access than you have. station assigns a free station in your project; an embodied child's body appears inside it. Returns the child's ID, checkout path and branch before its work finishes; results and attention requests arrive automatically. The child shares your checkout unless useWorktree is set. Never repeat creation after an unknown outcome; inspect existing children first.

provider.description: Defaults to the profile's provider; a different provider than the profile's is rejected.

body.description: Entity type for an embodied child's NPC, such as minecraft:fox. Omit for a random one.

title.description: Short title for the child's work, shown under its name. A new worktree's branch is named from it.

useWorktree.description: Create a separate managed checkout of the project primary repository. Omit or false to share the parent’s exact current checkout.

baseRef.description: Optional Git starting ref for a new worktree. Omit to start from your current commit; requires useWorktree.

profile.description: Name of a saved agent profile. Project, checkout, permissions and communication still come from you.

station.description: ID of a free station from agent_stations. Unknown or occupied stations are rejected.

name: agent_message
description: Send another agent a follow-up attributed to you. Auto steers a busy agent when supported and otherwise queues; queue waits for the current turn. Accepted queued delivery is not a failure: do not resend. Include the full message and a short summary shown to the player when communication announcements are enabled. The host enforces both agents’ communication settings.

summary.description: One short, plain-text sentence for the player chat (120 characters maximum). Summarize the request or reply; do not repeat names or include private details.

name: agent_read
description: Read an agent conversation snapshot, latest output, pending attention and its children. Omit agentId to inspect yourself. Inspection does not approve requests or start work.

name: agent_wait
description: Wait for one of the selected agents to finish or need attention, then return snapshots. Child results also arrive automatically; prefer doing independent work instead of polling. Timeout returns current state and does not stop agents.

name: agent_stop
description: Stop only the selected agent and any world action it is running. Its children remain independently controllable; its conversation and results remain available. This does not approve requests or delete a body.

name: agent_stations
description: List your project's stations: ID, label, occupant and, for embodied agents, box.

name: agent_archive
description: Archive one of your own children: removes its body, archives its conversation and frees its station. Its checkout, branch and files are kept. Fails while the child has active work or pending requests. Never repeat after an unknown outcome; inspect existing children first.
